canonical_name: Ore's degree-sum criterion for Hamiltonian graphs
literal_source_claim_en: A degree-sum condition for the existence of a Hamiltonian cycle.
statement_blocker: The catalog omits the finite simple undirected graph model, the lower bound of three vertices, distinctness of the nonadjacent pair, the exact degree-sum inequality and binder order, and the Hamilton-circuit convention. Only bibliographic metadata for the likely primary paper was available. Choosing these details without source and convention review would invent an exact target.
candidate_human_statement_not_credited: For every finite simple undirected graph G on n >= 3 vertices, if degree_G(u) + degree_G(v) >= n for every pair of distinct nonadjacent vertices u and v, then G contains a Hamiltonian cycle.

canonical_formal_target.candidate_expression: forall {V : Type u} [Fintype V] (G : SimpleGraph V), 3 <= Fintype.card V -> (forall u v, u != v -> not G.Adj u v -> Fintype.card V <= G.degree u + G.degree v) -> G.IsHamiltonian
